explication: Vibing Steampunk is an MCP and CLI bridge for SAP ABAP Development Tools. An AI assistant or engineer invokes MCP tools or CLI commands; authentication establishes a session, the ADT client routes requests over HTTPS or RFC, and SAP returns code, analysis, deployments, diagnostics, debugger state, or operational data. Core stages are interface routing, authenticated transport, ABAP development operations, debugging/observability, and offline context tooling. The tree and excerpts support these boundaries; several capability branches are represented from documented README claims without asserting unsampled call details.
